items.why: Every path resolves: earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change exceeds the receivables and inventory builds, and free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital is negative. The 'what' says payables 'helped lift' conversion. The title's 'carries' overstates it, since 8k_2_02:37 also shows the other current and non-current liabilities line swinging sharply.

trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets is 'highest of the 5 filled years' and the only positive annual cell (trends:accruals_over_total_assets:2024-09-29..2025-09-27). earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income is the lowest in the history.

earnings_versus_cash.smoothness is below one, as stated. But the claim that 'The biggest divergence is the December quarter' fails: smoothness.operating_cash_flow.7 against smoothness.net_income.7 (quarter to 2024-09-28) is a wider gap than index 2. The cited quarterly-accruals item does not bear on smoothness.

receivables_over_revenue and days_sales_outstanding rise from years-back-3 to years-back-0, which is 'highest of the 5 filled years' (trends:receivables_over_revenue:2024-09-29..2025-09-27). quarters-back-0 DSO sits below quarters-back-4, as stated.
concentration.facts.3, .7 and .11 rise and concentration.facts.0 through .12 fall, as written. 0000320193-26-000020:notes:29 states the same current and year-end shares and names no customer.

trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue is 'highest of the 5 filled years', and terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities exceeds terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities. notes:7 states a higher total deferred revenue.

Both quotes are verbatim in 0000320193-26-000018:8k_2_02:7. mdna:45 names the refunds without an amount, and trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin is 'highest of the 6 filled quarters'. This bears on the earnings run rate.

trend_table.years-back-4.ratios.warranty_reserve_ratio is 'the only filled year'. The calculator prints bad_debt_allowance as missing for every recent date and inventory_reserve as missing in any period.

mdna:60 and mdna:61 cite changes in unrecognized tax benefits in three roles: an offset to the higher quarterly rate, a cause of the higher nine-month rate, and a reason the rate sits below statutory. They give no amount. tax_rate.effective_rate is the only rate the calculator holds.
notes:58 is carried as text with no prior version in the inputs, and it names no matter and no accrual, exactly as stated. The calculator holds no contingency accrual.

8k_2_02:33 and notes:38 both show intangible assets rising since 2025-09-27, and terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions prints no acquisition line. No input paragraph says what was added. The soft_asset_share paths resolve with the positions quoted.

terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure is below both terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure and terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization. mdna:54 and mdna:68 carry the infrastructure and capital-asset wording, and the anomaly claims no shift.

0000320193-25-000079:facts:OtherAssetsNoncurrent:2025-09-27 prints a higher value than the release's 2025-09-27 other non-current assets in 8k_2_02:33, which adds an intangible line the 10-K lacked. No reclassification note exists, and the stated benign carve-out reading fits notes:38.

notes:38 bridges the 10-Q's total intangible assets, net to the release's 'Non-current portion of intangible assets, net' through the current portion. The documents agree, so 'As filed, though, the two documents disagree on the same caption' is wrong. This is a dealbreaker.

terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations matches neither figure in mdna:66 or mdna:68, as stated. notes:55 limits the schedule to obligations 'with a remaining term in excess of one year', which fits the anomaly's scope reading.

The notes:45 quote is verbatim, and terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases.parts.this_year_to_date.value differs from it. The trade-date versus settlement account is not in the inputs, and the anomaly leaves the gap unreconciled.

Everything matches. terms.balances_now.inventory exceeds terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory, and quarters-back-0 days_sales_of_inventory is 'highest of the 6 filled quarters'. notes:34 shows components up and finished goods down. The calculator lists inventory_reserve and inventory_write_down as missing in any period.

The 8k_2_02:5 and 8k_2_02:7 quotes are verbatim, mdna:13 gives no refund amount, and ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter and .year_over_year resolve. A record EPS that rests partly on refunds bears on the earnings run rate.
ratios.liquidity.current_ratio and quick_ratio resolve, and terms.balances_a_year_earlier.current_assets is below current_liabilities, as stated. The mdna:66 quote is verbatim.
The mdna:11 quote is verbatim, and trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin is 'highest of the 6 filled quarters'.

quarters-back-0 and quarters-back-4 gross_margin read 'highest' and 'lowest of the 6 filled quarters'. The 8k_2_02:7 quote is verbatim, and mdna:45 names the refunds. A non-recurring lift in the peak margin changes how the company is valued.

terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense exceeds its parts.prior_fiscal_year, and the mdna:54 quote is verbatim. ratios.profitability.operating_margin exceeds earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin.
The mdna:61 quote is verbatim, and mdna:59 shows both the quarterly and the nine-month rates higher year over year. tax_rate and terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense resolve.

trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory is 'highest of the 6 filled quarters', and the inventory balances and terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory resolve. notes:34 places the build in components.

The notes:29 quote is verbatim. quarters-back-0 receivables_over_revenue is 'second highest of the 6 filled quarters', years-back-0 DSO is 'highest of the 5 filled years', and bad_debt_allowance is missing.

ratios.solvency.liabilities_over_assets, ratios.profitability.dupont.equity_multiplier and the notes:45 quote resolve. terms.debt_now is below terms.debt_a_year_earlier, so 'falling' holds, and equity rose as stated.

Revenue and operating income quarter_over_quarter are the only negative values in ratios.growth, and net income and operating cash flow are positive. 'the only negative growth readings in the file' overreaches, since earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.revenue_growth is also negative.

coverage.why: All seven accounting areas and industry_lens carry a finding and a verdict. The financial analysis answers profitability, efficiency, liquidity, solvency, growth and free_cash_flow, plus dupont and path_to_distress. input_manifest.json analysis_stages shows dropped 0 for both analyses.

calibration.why: Area verdicts follow their anomalies. For example, estimates_and_reserves names the tariff-refund benefit and the untagged reserves, and cost_deferral names the unexplained intangible rise. The cross_document_reconciliation verdict matches its anomalies but carries over the struck intangible-line claim.

valuation_reading.why: price_position and market_implied_growth read 'Not computed', citing market.missing and implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth.missing. most_sensitive says which assumption moves value most 'cannot be read here' because of valuation.missing. The reading declines to estimate rather than inventing figures.
